assessments.summary: The argument establishes exact product additivity of the averaged separately-relaxed UV sum-rate functional for finite-alphabet discrete memoryless broadcast channels, equality of the branchwise and averaged functionals on receiver-skew channels and their finite products, and the stated exact value n(2h_2(1/4)-5/4) for every finite power of the half-skew BSSC. The general product and receiver-skew arguments are established internally; the declared reference supplies the logically necessary global sharp BSSC support inequality used in the specialization.
scopeQualifications: The theorem concerns only the two separately-relaxed scalar UV functionals.
It does not establish tensorization of the full UV region, optimization over a common joint (U,V), the GK functional, broadcast-channel capacity, or capacity tensorization.
The executable attestation checks selected numerical and algebraic facts but not the global support inequality, concave-envelope optimization, or product theorem; those are discharged analytically.
The README decimal approximation is inaccurate, but the exact expression in the claim is correct and unaffected.
